positiveDefinition: Explicit prize/draw + mandatory payment specifically to participate (including mandatory purchase, donation, ticket, number, or slot) + random winner, without contradiction.

provenance.createdBy: A separate AI agent instructed not to inspect the classifier, existing corpora, reports, or engine behavior.
provenance.sourceType: Newly authored synthetic scenarios; no real platform posts.
provenance.annotationType: Expected labels and rationales authored by the same independent AI agent.
provenance.independenceLimit: Independence refers to authoring without reading the implementation or prior datasets. This is not independent human annotation.

freezeProtocol.protocol: Parent developed rules using prior data and five explicit development probes. Independent v2 cases and labels had not been opened or evaluated by parent. No engine tuning after first v2 evaluation is allowed for this release.
freezeProtocol.labelScope: Textual indicators and triage priority; not fraud or legal status.

developmentProbes.text: Разыграем планшет. Для участия покупать не нужно. Победителя определит рандом.
Ұтыс: сыйлық — сағат. Қатысу үшін төлеу керек емес. Жеңімпаз кездейсоқ таңдалады.
Разыграем книгу. Ничего покупать не требуется. Случайный выбор.
Жүлде бар. Қазылар алқасы жеңімпазды таңдайды, кездейсоқ таңдау емес.
Розыгрыш смартфона. Покупать товар не нужно, но билет за 2000 тенге обязателен. Победителя выберет рандом.

freezeProtocol.note: The last probe remains medium conservatively: a no-purchase clause plus a mandatory ticket requires manual reconciliation. It is not treated as free participation.

independent.dataset: 100 synthetic cases authored by a separate engine-blinded AI agent; not human or real-world validation
independent.positiveDefinition: high: observed prize + mandatory entry payment + random selection, without unresolved contradiction
limitations: Synthetic authored scenarios with limited wording variation.
Used for implementation checks; not an independently blinded evaluation.
Medium cases remain in the denominator for binary metrics.
OCR quality is not evaluated by this text scenario benchmark.

annotationAgreement.method: Two separate AI annotations, second blinded to engine, predictions and first labels. Not human inter-rater reliability.

limitations: 100 synthetic cases by a separate AI agent; not representative real platform data.
First author provided expected labels; second AI agreement does not replace expert human adjudication.
Engine frozen before first v2 run; no tuning on v2 after results.
